semiconductor_relevance: High — Plasma-Therm specializes in advanced plasma processing equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Plasma-Therm is a global leader in advanced plasma processing equipment, focusing on etch, deposition, and material modification technologies. Their products are designed to serve various industries, including wireless communication and MEMS, ensuring reliability and exceptional support for their global customer base.

regional_presence.North America: Plasma-Therm has sales and service locations to support its customer base in North America.
regional_presence.Europe: The company maintains a presence in Europe to cater to its global clientele.
regional_presence.Asia-Pacific: Plasma-Therm serves the Asia-Pacific region, enhancing its global reach.
